_comentario: Mapa de classes Coralscapes -> YOLO-seg. Chave = valor do pixel na mascara PNG, valor = id da classe YOLO. Valores nao listados sao ignorados (fundo, peixe, areia, humano, etc). IDs conferidos no dataset card oficial do EPFL-ECEO/coralscapes.
_vivos: 10 classes: other coral alive, massive/meandering alive, millepora, branching alive, acropora alive, turbinaria, table acropora alive, pocillopora alive, stylophora alive, meandering alive
_branqueados: 4 classes: other coral bleached, massive/meandering bleached, branching bleached, meandering bleached
_mortos: 5 classes: other coral dead, branching dead, massive/meandering dead, table acropora dead, meandering dead
